title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: Uses ellmer Chat object (e.g., ellmer::chat_google_gemini() ellmer::chat_ollama()) classify device data following: device: Flags whether item truly medical device ("yes" ""), excluding non-device products creams, pharmaceuticals, integral drug-device medicines, nutritional feeds. Class: Assigns medical devices EU/UK MDR risk class (Class , Class IIa, Class IIb, Class III) EU/UK IVDR risk class (IVD (Class ), IVD (Class B), IVD (Class C), IVD (Class D)). FDA medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices FDA clinical speciality (18 clinical specialities plus ). MHRA medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices MHRA speciality (10 clinical specialities plus ). EMA medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices EMA Medical Device Expert Panel (12 thematic panels plus ). EMDN category: Assigns true medical devices top-level European Medical Device Nomenclature (EMDN) category (23 lettered categories, -Z including Annex XVI Category X, plus ). Implantable: Flags whether medical devices implantable ("yes" ""). Active status: Flags whether medical devices active/powered ("yes" ""). Software status: Flags whether medical devices standalone Software Medical Device / SaMD ("yes" "").

title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: chat ellmer Chat object (ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))). data data.frame tibble containing device_name column used classify devices. maxRetries Maximum number attempts concept returning NA_character_. batchSize Number unique device names classify per LLM request. Keep low (e.g., 1L-5L) smaller local models maintain structured-output reliability, higher (e.g., 20L-50L) larger frontier models reduce request overhead latency.

title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
text: tibble original rows columns data, plus: is_medical_device: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_). device_class: Character ("Class ", "Class IIa", "Class IIb", "Class III", "IVD (Class )", "IVD (Class B)", "IVD (Class C)", "IVD (Class D)", NA_character_ device failed). fda_medical_speciality: Character (one 19 FDA medical specialities, NA_character_ device failed). mhra_medical_speciality: Character (one 11 MHRA medical specialities, NA_character_ device failed). ema_medical_speciality: Character (one 13 EMA medical specialities, NA_character_ device failed). emdn_category: Character (one 23 EMDN top-level categories "", NA_character_ device failed). is_implantable: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_ device failed). is_active: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_ device failed). is_software: Character ("yes", "", NA_character_ device failed).

title: Classify medical devices — classifyMedicalDevices
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(dplyr) library(ellmer)  devices <- tibble(   device_id = 1:5,   device_name = c(     "Medtronic Micra AV",     "Stryker Triathlon CR Femoral Component",     "FreeStyle Optium blood glucose test strips",     "BD Alaris GP Volumetric Pump",     "Diprobase cream"   ) )  # Using a cloud model (e.g., Google Gemini or OpenAI) chat <- chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.5-flash") res <- classifyMedicalDevices(chat, devices)  # Or using a local model via Ollama local_chat <- chat_ollama(   model = "qwen2.5:7b",   api_args = list(temperature = 0) ) res_local <- classifyMedicalDevices(   local_chat,   devices,   batchSize = 1L ) } # }

Example medical devices and non-device clinical products — device_test_set

what: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
title: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
text: Uses vitals package evaluate ellmer Chat model's accuracy classifyMedicalDevices() labelled benchmark dataset. Runs classifyMedicalDevices() produces separate vitals Task accuracy score ("C" = Correct, "" = Incorrect) nine classification columns: is_medical_device: Scored across rows data. device_class, fda_medical_speciality, mhra_medical_speciality, ema_medical_speciality, emdn_category, is_implantable, is_active, is_software: Scored across true medical devices (expected_is_medical_device == "yes").

title: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
text: chat ellmer Chat object evaluate. data labelled benchmark data.frame tibble containing device_name, expected_is_medical_device, expected_device_class, expected_fda_medical_speciality, expected_mhra_medical_speciality, expected_ema_medical_speciality, expected_emdn_category, expected_is_implantable, expected_is_active, expected_is_software. batchSize Integer passed classifyMedicalDevices(). maxRetries Integer passed classifyMedicalDevices().

title: Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark — evaluateDeviceClassifier
text: list (invisibly) three elements: summary: tibble column, n_evaluated, n_correct, accuracy (percentage) nine columns. tasks: named list nine evaluated vitals Task objects (is_medical_device, device_class, fda_medical_speciality, mhra_medical_speciality, ema_medical_speciality, emdn_category, is_implantable, is_active, is_software). Use vitals::vitals_bind() combine res$tasks$device_class$view() inspect specific column. results: tibble combining data model's predictions logical any_incorrect flag (TRUE evaluated column row match expected value).

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(ellmer) library(vitals)  chat <- chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.5-flash") eval_res <- evaluateDeviceClassifier(chat, benchmark_data, batchSize = 20L) eval_res$summary dplyr::filter(eval_res$results, any_incorrect) } # }

what: Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs — mapDeviceConcepts
title: Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs — mapDeviceConcepts
text: Queries ragnar vector store standard OMOP Device concepts map device_name data single standard OMOP concept_id. device name top retrieval hit within maxCosineDistance mapped automatically. remaining device names without automatic match: chat NULL, mapped 0L. ellmer Chat object supplied expandQueries TRUE, LLM first translates brand names abbreviations generic clinical device description (flagging non-devices directly 0L), retrieves additional candidates using description, selects single best concept_id (0L) combined candidate list.

title: Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs — mapDeviceConcepts
code: mapDeviceConcepts(   data,   store,   chat = NULL,   maxCosineDistance = 0.15,   topK = 5L,   expandQueries = TRUE,   maxRetries = 3L )

title: Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs — mapDeviceConcepts
text: data data.frame tibble containing device_name column used map devices. store RagnarStore object created buildDeviceConceptStore() opened via ragnar::ragnar_store_connect(). chat Optional ellmer Chat object (ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))) used review device names automatically matched within maxCosineDistance. Defaults NULL (retrieval-). maxCosineDistance Numeric. Maximum cosine_distance required automatic match (lower stricter). Defaults 0.15. topK Integer. Maximum number unique candidate concepts retrieve per search pass (raw term , enabled, expanded description) LLM review. Defaults 5L. expandQueries Logical. TRUE (default) chat provided, uses chat generate generic clinical description unmatched terms runs second retrieval pass final selection. maxRetries Integer. Maximum number LLM attempts per step falling back. Defaults 3L.

title: Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs — mapDeviceConcepts
text: tibble original rows columns data, plus: concept_id: Integer standard OMOP concept_id (0L unmapped confident match found).

title: Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs — mapDeviceConcepts
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(dplyr) library(ellmer)  devices <- tibble(   device_id = 1:3,   device_name = c(     "Medtronic Micra AV",     "drug-eluting coronary stent",     "Diprobase cream"   ) )  local_chat <- chat_ollama(   model = "qwen2.5:7b",   api_args = list(temperature = 0) )  res <- mapDeviceConcepts(   data = devices,   store = store,   chat = local_chat,   maxCosineDistance = 0.15,   expandQueries = TRUE ) } # }
